headline: Mr Price Chief Executive Criticizes Software Changes at Durban Container Port
summary: Retail group Mr Price's CEO expressed concerns over operational software modifications implemented at the Durban port terminal close to peak shopping season, warning of supply chain disruptions.
why: Mr Price Group is a major South African value retailer dependent on smooth port operations for apparel and homeware imports.

impacts.name: Mr Price Group Limited
impacts.why: Port congestion poses inventory delivery risks ahead of peak festive trading.
